Ellaria was one of the high elves of Quel'lithien Lodge who succumbed to the corruption of a magical item found by Ranger-Lord Hawkspear, which transformed them into Wretched. Kirkian Dawnshield, who managed to avoid being corrupted by fleeing from the lodge, speaks of her as "my Ellaria" and states that she wouldn't want to "live like that", nor would any of his brothers, and thus sends adventurers to kill the Wretched at Quel'lithien. Ellaria's status, whereabouts and her exact relation to Kirkian are unknown.

__NOTOC__ Elsharin is a high elf mage trainer located at the Wizard's Sanctum in the Mage Quarter within the human city of Stormwind. She trains the newest generation of mages in the ways of the arcane.

Elysa was a quest giver located on the top floor of the Dandred's Fold mansion in northwestern Alterac Mountains. She was forced into becoming Aliden Perenolde's mistress, and was given a necklace that once belonged to Taretha Foxton. She seemingly accompanied Aliden wherever he went. When the Horde adventurers traveled to Dandred's Fold to retrieve Taretha's necklace, they killed Aliden. Elysa, very frightened, plead them to spare her, stating she never meant any harm to their people and that Aliden held her against her will. She then gave the champions the necklace. Following the Cataclysm, she is nowhere to be found.

Elrendar Falls is a waterfall just south of Farstrider Retreat in Eversong Woods. It pours from Lake Elrendar into one of its many rivers, flowing northwest towards the North Sea. Its water is so pure that it is used for magic.

and an elven ranger.]] rangers.]] Elven ranger refers to a ranger of elven ancestry. The term is arbitrarily used, for elven rangers are simply identified as "rangers" in the overwhelming majority of canon sources. Elven rangers are elite archers turning to nature for aid, befriending animals. Some of them possess minor druidic abilities, as Vereesa Windrunner was able to use the "language of the trees, of all plants", and sense a plant's emotions and history through touch. Most current-day elven rangers are (or were once) part of the thalassian Farstriders.
Elune's Tear is a magical stone supposedly with curative properties.

The story behind the runestone at Caer Darrow originally mentioned being placed there by "Elven Druids", implying that they were high elves from Quel'Thalas. The high elves themselves were originally depicted as much closer to nature, with their reason for joining the Alliance of Lordaeron being partly because the Old Horde intended to defile the very lands of Lordaeron. The druidic night elves were later added into the lore with the introduction of Warcraft III, and the backstory between high elves and night elves was extended to show the high elves as being more in tune with magic than nature. .]]

The Elven Ranger Corps was a high elven organization that encompassed the elven rangers of Quel'Thalas, masters of marksmanship and scouting. It was charged with the defense of Quel'Thalas and led by the Ranger-General of Silvermoon, leader of the high elves' military forces. During the Third War, this organization was led by Sylvanas Windrunner. The Elven Ranger Corps met Arthas Menethil at the borders of Quel'Thalas and fought the traitorous prince every step of the way, through both the Inner and Outer Elfgates, back towards the high elven capital. This Elwynn Forest questing guide details the best way to obtain and complete quests in Elwynn Forest. For a list of all Elwynn Forest quests in table format, see Elwynn Forest quests. Note: This guide is not meant for power-leveling purposes. Rather, it is meant to show a player the most efficient way to complete all quests available for a particular zone. If you know of a better order or method to accomplish this, your input is welcome (in fact, greatly desired). For major changes, feel free to edit, but make a note in the talk page as to your reasoning.

The Ember Clutch is an area of magic-enhanced-perpetual forest fire located in west-central Howling Fjord. These woods were once a peaceful place where proto-dragons could lay their eggs and raise their young without harm. When the vrykul awoken all that changed. Ember Clutch Ancients watch over the area.

Ember Tap is a Destruction warlock ability, available at level 42. Ember Tap will spend a single Burning Ember to heal the Warlock. While Ember Tap's standard healing is very weak, there are a number of effects that can significantly increase its healing potential. Which of these you should select will depend both on the type of content you are doing, whether you have healers in your party or are soloing, and how much healing said healers will be able to provide you with, if applicable.

The Elven Defenders was a high elven organization tasked with defending Quel'Thalas and by the time of the Third War they answered to the ranger-general of Silvermoon, Sylvanas Windrunner. When the Undead Scourge led by Prince Arthas attacked the kingdom, the Scourge was forced to fight the Elven Defenders regardless of which forest area they decided to move through. During the battle that followed the Elven Defenders were beaten back and the Scourge was able to move past the Outer Gate and move further into Quel'Thalas. The Emerald Archives is an Highborne library and the subzone of the Cathedral of Eternal Night. Thrashbite the Scornful and his fel minions has been dispatched to wipe out the mortals entering the Cathedral's grand library. The dimwitted mo'arg lacks any respect for knowledge or learning, feeling petty satisfaction as he crashes through ancient artifacts and tramples priceless tomes. During the battle for the library, some of the ancient tomes fly up and cast spells over the combatants.

The Emerald Forest is found within the unreleased Emerald Dream zone. The forest is full of huge floating trees as well as winding streams. A few large untextured round objects can also be found scattered throughout the area. A large river bisects the zone in two, from northeast to southwest, ending in an unfinished lake found in a large empty plain. There are green dragonflight minions in some areas of the forest. <!--

He can be found in the Petitioner's Chamber, the first room to the left when entering through the keep's main entrance. When he came to Stormwind, he brought Farseer Umbrua with him. After the fall of Theramore, Taluun was present during a meeting with King Varian and other Alliance leaders and ambassadors to determine the best course of action in response to the Horde's blockade of Kalimdor.

An empire is a political entity which either governs over vast lands and territories compared to its neighbors, or has subjugated multiple nations and races under its rule. Most empires tend to have their foundations laid out during bloody wars of conquest, which are all predominantly carried out in the name of a powerful king, ancient, god, or other venerated being or entity. Many empires also see fit to take their conquered foes as slaves or menial servants, though there are rare examples of some empires instead choosing to extend the rights of their citizens to the conquered, in exchange for pledges of loyalty.
